name: agent-central-mcp
stderr:
This npm package is a name reservation, not an Agent Central server.

Agent Central is hosted, so there is nothing to install. Connect your MCP client to:

  https://mcp.agentcentral.to/mcp
  Header: Authorization: Bearer ac_live_<YOUR_API_KEY>

Claude and ChatGPT use the Connector URL from your Agent Central dashboard instead.
Setup guides: https://agentcentral.to/docs/quickstart/claude

For an MCP client that can only start a local command, use the official CLI bridge:

  npx -y @agentcentral/cli mcp serve
  https://agentcentral.to/docs/cli/bridge
